aggregation: Each of3primary routes must independently achieve>=90 AND all hard gates; averaging or dropping home forbidden. No discretionary partial points. Each criterion either earns its full weight or0 with exact span/rationale.

normalization.text: Decode HTML entities; Unicode NFC; replace every Unicode whitespace run with ASCII single space; trim ends; retain punctuation; count Unicode code points, not bytes. Do not remove brand or punctuation for length.
normalization.title: Read actual rendered <title>. Allowed separators for front position: |, ｜, ·, —. First-half endpoint is floor(codepointCount/2); geography+service must both end at/before it AND before first separator if present.
normalization.h1: Exactly one visible main H1; read rendered text. Header logo/nav not included.
normalization.firstAnswer: The first actual visible customer-facing prose after the page H1 in main DOM reading order is the firstAnswer. The author-marked first-answer element must start there. No earlier unscored hero lead, sales paragraph, greeting or explanatory prose may intervene. Extract visible textContent in reading order, excluding heading/nav/breadcrumb/button/hidden/script/style text. Author field and rendered text must match normalized digest. Earlier prose makes the extraction gate FAIL, not an ignored prefix.
normalization.first120and180: Store normalized full firstAnswer, first120 code points and first180 code points; direct core answer begins within first120 and all scored content is assessed in first180. Target full firstAnswer120–180characters; if longer or shorter, reviewer records reason rather than fabricating text for length. No length points; missing direct answer is F02=0 and hard-gate review.

summaryChecks.normalization: Use the same Unicode NFC/entity decode/whitespace normalization as A04; retain punctuation. Compare Unicode code points.
summaryChecks.startsPrimary: cardSummary starts with normalized primary_keyword => FAIL.
summaryChecks.commonLeadingTitle: Compute literal common prefix length of normalized cardSummary and title; >8codepoints => REVISE.
summaryChecks.firstAnswerSimilarity: Compute LCS (longest common subsequence) length L on normalized complete cardSummary and complete firstAnswer. similarity=2L/(len(cardSummary)+len(firstAnswer)); if both empty, similarity=1. Ratio>=0.70 => REVISE. Record both normalized strings, lengths, L and ratio.
summaryChecks.siblingTemplate: Compare summaries after masking only the explicit region/facility entity strings listed in target map/source assignments. Identical remaining text => REVISE; near-template judgments must quote the repeated span and explain. No automatic rewriting or lexeme padding.
